answer: Each epoch, every identity enters a ranked tournament of five fresh verifiable tasks. Scores are published as a lantern: clones betray themselves when ten identities post identical scores within 0.1 points. The bottom 10% lose admission and forfeit a 10-credit bond, so 100 clones risk 1,000 credits. Like a river, the task pool flows onward and old answers never repeat, so each clone needs real skill: 40 GPU-hours at $0.50 an hour, $20 per clone, $2,000 for the army. Admission is a velvet rope that only rises. Like a marathon cutting the slowest tenth each lap, clones cannot keep pace.
